# StoryOp

One variable operation in a [Story](Story.md)'s script. All story state is
named integer variables, starting at `0` each playthrough: a plain flag
is a variable set to `1` and cleared to `0`.

## Parameters

- `name`: A string. The variable name.
- `value`: An integer. The value assigned (or added).
- `add`: A boolean. `false` assigns `value`; `true` adds it to the current value.
